Name: Christmas_Yeti_Cave_Line
$Comment: Bram's way into the Yeti Cave, one line on his conversations while Christmas runs. Dialogues.Ids names
his Christmas conversation and his Harvest Feast one: while the feast's last days still run he
speaks his feast conversation (NpcPlacements/Harvest_Feast_Shepherd_Temple.json takes its feast entry
first), so the cave opens from the first day of Christmas all the same.
It lands on the screens a conversation opens on, after a screen's own lines and before the goodbye
group, so goodbye stays last. Season offers it only while Christmas runs; to take it out, set Enabled
false in a file of the same name. Open is the Dungeon destination: picking it opens CommonLib's
confirm screen with the cave's name and description, the Yeti Bait, how many the player holds and
how many it takes; its button spends the bait and sends the player in with their party, and with
none the button is off and the screen says where Yeti Bait comes from (the dungeon's HintKey). A
partymate following into a cave their party already holds skips the screen and walks in free. The
label names the price, since option labels take no number from the file: change it with the
